title: Optimize rules and review repo structure
description: Reference when compacting .agents/rules, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md under the one-constraint-one-owner principle, or when considering restructuring the .agents/.claude/.codex directories.

meta.objective: Shorter rules, fewer tokens, no lost constraints; propose a repo structure that keeps symlinks and installer/hook paths unchanged.
meta.inScope: .agents/rules/*.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md; review of the .agents/.claude/.codex/docs/bin/scripts/tests structure.
meta.currentState: Rules + AGENTS + CLAUDE + CONTRACT = 33366 bytes (wc -c); the same constraints repeated in 3-5 places; check-agent-config passes.

requirements.description: Remove duplication/verbosity in rules, move procedures to skills, lose no constraint
requirements.source: User request via the dispatcher session, plan approved 2026-10-22

requirements.description: Review and propose the repo structure, keeping relative symlinks and installer/hook paths
requirements.source: User request via the dispatcher session, plan approved 2026-10-22

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every removed constraint still exists at its owner (CONTRACT, rule owner or skill); all headings/anchors unchanged
Total bytes lower than 33366; check-agent-config passes; git diff --check clean; npm test passes

assumptions: User decided 2026-10-22: do M1 per the meaning in .claude/commands/git.md (commit all = all valid changes except forbidden files; commit change when the user chooses it explicitly) and O1 (delete settings.snippet.json, hooks README points to settings.json/installer).
content.technicalSolution: Assign owners: scope/change authorization → coding.md#kiss-yagni-và-phạm-vi; UI gate → frontend.md; pre-handoff checks → delivery.md#chất-lượng-và-bằng-chứng; testcase when plan done → docs.md; bug/git/report procedures → skills debugs, git-workflow, report. Elsewhere only link. Structure kept as-is because reversing the agents/commands/hooks symlinks would require editing the installer, checker and tests.
